title: Vibe-IC IP Catalog Manifest
description: Schema for ip-catalog/<category>/<ip>/manifest.yaml. Plugin queries this at spec-to-rtl time to select pre-validated open-source IPs.

ip_version.description: Semantic version of the IP release this manifest pins to (e.g. '1.4.0')

license.description: SPDX identifier. ONLY permissive licenses (no GPL family) — see ip-catalog/README.md

canonical_commit.description: Pinned commit SHA for this manifest entry (reproducibility)

authors.description: Original IP authors (for attribution in declaration.json + GDS metadata)

description.description: 1-2 sentence summary of what this IP does

implements.description: Capability claims that Plugin uses to match against L1-L27 spec facts

matches_when.description: Plain-English query patterns Plugin's catalog selector evaluates against L1-L27 facts. Each pattern is a chip-AGNOSTIC condition on extracted spec facts.

synth_safe_params.description: Synthesis-safety hints for IP parameters that gate UNSYNTHESIZABLE constructs (e.g. a 'sim'/'debug' parameter that enables a generate block using $value$plusargs / $fopen / $display / other PLI or system tasks). When the Plugin (catalog-glue-author) instantiates this IP it MUST apply each listed param->synth_safe_value by default, overriding the manifest interface.parameters default, so downstream yosys/OpenLane synthesis does not abort on the simulation-only construct. The functional oracle / reference TB is unaffected — it may still set the param to its sim value during simulation, but the SYNTHESIS instantiation pins the synth-safe value. chip-AGNOSTIC: this is per-IP catalog data, not detection logic.

synth_safe_value.description: Value to pin at synthesis time (int / string). Apply this by default when instantiating for synth.

sim_value.description: Value the param takes for simulation/verification (the value that triggers the unsynthesizable construct). Documentary — NOT applied at synth.

reason.description: Why this param must be pinned for synthesis (e.g. 'gates a sim-only generate block using $value$plusargs/$fopen — unsynthesizable by yosys').

rtl_files.description: List of RTL file paths (relative to upstream repo root) Plugin should pull when this IP is selected

integration_notes.description: Free-text guide for wrapping (e.g. 'Pair with shared_sram_rf for memory port match')

depends_on.description: Other catalog IPs this IP requires (e.g. SERV requires servile wrapper)
